summary: Template class harness scenarios for request-to-classify-to-plan-to-execute-to-verify flows. These scenarios identify the expected evidence chain but do not create a new runtime execution engine.

scenarios.request_shape: Add invoice line items, extend line total formulas, protect formulas, and emit a printable invoice sheet.
success_evidence: workbookcase preview evidence includes append, formulas, validation, protection, printable form

scenarios.request_shape: Summarize monthly budget actuals and flag over-budget variance rows.
success_evidence: planner emits summary and threshold atoms
organism verifier confirms deterministic summary and highlighted exceptions

scenarios.request_shape: Normalize inventory movement headers and reconcile movement balances with stock master quantities.
success_evidence: workbookcase reconciliation evidence reports deterministic buckets

scenarios.request_shape: Summarize student scores and validate completion status values.
success_evidence: verified-class contract excludes native pivot and grading policy claims

scenarios.request_shape: Extend loan payment-row formulas and protect calculated schedule cells.
success_evidence: planner emits formula extension and protection atoms
verified-class contract excludes amortization correctness and financial advice
